heading: Westminster Larger Catechism · The Fifth Commandment · WLC 123 … WLC 133

items.text: Honour father and mother, for this is the fifth commandment.
items.quote: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

items.text: Give all due reverence in heart, word, and behaviour; pray and give thanks for them; imitate their virtues and graces.
items.quote: all due reverence in heart, word, and behaviour; prayer and thanksgiving for them; imitation of their virtues and graces

items.text: Willingly obey their lawful commands and counsels and submit to their corrections.
items.quote: willing obedience to their lawful commands and counsels; due submission to their corrections

items.text: Be faithful to them, defend and maintain their persons and authority, and bear with their infirmities, covering them in love.
items.quote: fidelity to, defence, and maintenance of their persons and authority, according to their several ranks, and the nature of their places; bearing with their infirmities, and covering them in love

items.text: Do not neglect the duties required toward them, nor envy, despise, rebel, curse, mock, or bring shame and dishonour to them and their government.
items.quote: envying at, contempt of, and rebellion against, their persons and places, in their lawful counsels, commands, and corrections; cursing, mocking and all such refractory and scandalous carriage

items.text: As those styled father and mother, love, pray for, and bless your inferiors, expressing love and tenderness like natural parents.
items.quote: to love, pray for, and bless their inferiors

items.text: Instruct, counsel, and admonish them; commend and reward those who do well; reprove and chastise those who do ill.
items.quote: to instruct, counsel, and admonish them; countenancing, commending, and rewarding such as do well; and discountenancing, reproving, and chastising such as do ill

items.text: Protect and provide for them all things necessary for soul and body.
items.quote: protecting, and providing for them all things necessary for soul and body

items.text: By grave, wise, holy, and exemplary carriage, preserve the authority God has put upon you.
items.quote: by grave, wise, holy, and exemplary carriage, to procure glory to God, honour to themselves, and so to preserve that authority which God hath put upon them

items.text: Do not command what is unlawful or beyond their power, nor counsel or encourage them in evil, nor dissuade them from good, nor correct them unduly, nor expose them to wrong, temptation, or danger, nor provoke them to wrath.
items.quote: commanding things unlawful, or not in the power of inferiors to perform; counseling, encouraging, or favouring them in that which is evil

items.text: Regard one another's dignity and worth; give honour to one another; rejoice in each other's gifts and advancement as your own.
items.quote: to regard the dignity and worth of each other, in giving honour to go one before another; and to rejoice in each others’ gifts and advancement, as their own

items.text: Do not undervalue one another's worth, envy gifts, grieve at advancement or prosperity, or usurp pre-eminence one over another.
items.quote: the undervaluing of the worth, envying the gifts, grieving at the advancement of prosperity one of another; and usurping pre-eminence one over another
